constants.method: Median of independently rectified marker observations; frozen for subsequent batches

motion_model.validation_split: leave-one-entire-video-out; all queries of each complete free-roll stop remain together
motion_model.velocity_measurement: Past-only robust quadratic fit in 0.60 s; no future position enters the speed estimate
motion_model.selection: linear drag retained only if complete-video held-out segment MAE improves by >=10%
motion_model.training_weight: Each complete free-stop segment has equal total weight; Huber residual loss, delta=4cm
motion_model.applicability: After a cushion rebound, clean straight free rolling on this cloth; no further collision or hand contact; infinite plane prediction is an estimate
limitations: Spin/sliding cannot be measured from ball centers; empirical rolling law has shot-to-shot error
Predictions outside measured speed range require review; held-out error is not a calibrated extrapolation interval
Table-plane points are ball image centroids; elevation/parallax was not independently measured
